summary: Solid bash and YAML implementation. Script follows conventions (set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, source-safe design). Workflow uses correct triggers, least-privilege permissions, job dependencies. Main issue: workflow always passes --commits-file commits.txt without verifying existence; should check if file exists before passing, or allow fallback to git history. Also: sed interpolation in svb_write_version (line 176) injects $new into pattern but is safe since semver validation prevents special chars. Minor: svb_json_version fallback grep/sed parsing could miss edge cases. Otherwise excellent modular design, comprehensive error handling, clear comments.
